subject: .parallel incorrectly passed to function in m_ply?

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: .parallel incorrectly passed to function in m_ply?
parts:
Hi,

Consider this,

params <- expand.grid(a=seq(1,5), b=seq(1,5))
library(plyr)

foo <- function(a,b){
print("done")
}

m_ply(params, foo)
Error in function (a, b) : unused argument(s) (.parallel = FALSE)


Adding ... to the arguments of foo works, however. mdply, mlply and
maply don't have this problem,

be.quiet <- mlply(params, foo)

messages.subject: Re: .parallel incorrectly passed to function in m_ply?

That's because *_ply doesn't currently support parallel computation.
Hadley
